reasoning: The question asks if the US, Russia, or China will detonate a nuclear device between November 12, 2025 and April 1, 2026. As of March 6, 2026, we are within this window with less than 4 weeks remaining. No credible public reports indicate any of these nations have conducted nuclear detonations during this period. While Trump announced intentions to resume testing in late 2025, actual detonation would require significant preparation and would be immediately detected and widely reported. The comprehensive nuclear test ban treaty (CTBT) and international monitoring make clandestine testing implausible. Russia and China's denials/silence suggest no actual tests occurred. The probability of a detonation in the remaining ~26 days is extremely low.
